changelog:
BetterPrisons is now BetterCosmic — rebuilt from the ground up. Your old settings carry over.
The big changes: a brand-new config menu, an auto-updater that can install updates for you, on-screen toast notifications, and features that only turn on while you're on CosmicPrisons.
New: separate natural/summoned meteor toggles, name-mention chat alerts, satchel backpack support, per-satchel toggles, "only show full satchels", full-satchel toasts, White Scroll indicators, clue-scroll search by step number, a completed-clue indicator, more clue steps, a Blink trinket preview, and use-item-while-mining toggles.
Improvements: compact Satchel HUD, outlined clue numbers, updated PrisonBreak texture pack. Fixed enchant book costs.
